title: A local section of canonical derived evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$ and every open. Let $K,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, let $U$ be an open, and let $P$ be a complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules strictly perfect in the sense of [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Suppose given $e_K:RK\cong QP$, where $R$ is exact restriction. Put $H=R\mathcal Hom$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $D=H(K,\mathcal O_X[0])$, and use the derived tensor of [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let $g:N\otimes^L D\to H(K,N)$ be the adjunct, for the fixed canonical family [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection], of the associator followed by $1_N\otimes\mathrm{ev}$ and the right unitor, where $\mathrm{ev}$ is the image of $1_D$ under that family. There exists $s:RH(K,N)\to R(N\otimes^L D)$ with $s;R(g)=1_{RH(K,N)}$. Only this one inverse identity is asserted; no representative of N or comparison with a prescribed chain map is an input or a conclusion.

proof.text: Choose F as the localization object preimage of RN, with its canonical isomorphism eN. Apply strictlyPerfect_localHom_computations to obtain preservation of quasi-isomorphisms by Hom(P,-) and K-flatness of the ordinary dual.

Construct the ordinary evaluation chain map from localEvaluationDegreeMap and its differential identity. The component formula gives IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation. Apply exists_exactSource_evaluation_local_comparisons to obtain a,b and R(g);b=a;Q(f).
Strictly perfect ordinary evaluation makes f an isomorphism componentwise. Set s=b.hom;inv(Q(f));a.inv, postcompose the claimed identity with b.hom, use the square, and cancel the two inverse pairs.

theorem exists_strictlyPerfect_evaluation_local_section (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K N : schemeDerivedCategory X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hstrict : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (eK : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let D := H.obj (op K, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    let g := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) (N ⊗ D) K N).symm
      ((α_ N D K).hom ≫ N ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) D K (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (𝟙 D)) ≫
          (ρ_ N).hom)
    ∃ s : R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)) ⟶ R.obj (N ⊗ D),
      s ≫ R.map g = 𝟙 (R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)))
